scope: Independent read-only source-level review of OLP-0101..OLP-0200 against the pinned English source, frozen MSA baseline, Classical Arabic style specification, batch receipts, formal-errata audit, and terminology contract. No source, baseline, receipt, TeX, Git, network, or publication mutation was performed.

source_roots.path_resolution: For each unit, source_path, arabic_path, and target_path are the immutable paths recorded under the same id in evidence/classical/BASELINE.json. The compact unit records below bind those paths through the baseline hash.

method.reading: All 92 prose-bearing units were read in full in English, MSA, and Classical Arabic. Definitions, hypotheses, polarity and negation, quantifier scope, formula references, proof steps, examples, exercises, and Arabic discourse flow were checked. The eight heading/import drivers were compared structurally in all three witnesses.
method.hash_readback: All 300 English/MSA/Classical unit files were SHA-256 read back. Every English and MSA hash equals BASELINE.json and every Classical target hash equals its applicable batch receipt.
method.receipt_policy: Receipt assertions were treated as leads, not semantic proof. Every receipt-declared unresolved issue in this range was independently checked.
method.formal_errata_policy: FORMAL_ERRATA_AUDIT_0001_0100 contains no in-range record because its declared scope ends at OLP-0100; that absence was not treated as evidence that OLP-0101..0200 were error-free.
method.style_assessment: The 92 prose-bearing targets are genuine rephrasings in a coherent Classical-Arabic-leaning scholarly register, not mechanical word substitution. Four localized grammar/calque defects are recorded below; their presence prevents an unqualified style acceptance.
limitations: This is a source-level review, not a rendered typography or bidirectional-layout review.
No proof assistant checked the mathematics; proof findings are reasoned source audits.
PASS means no additional defect was found in this bounded review, not a guarantee of absence.
No official dictionary or external terminology authority was queried because this task forbade network use.

static_validation.invocation: python -B -c import/run build/validate_classical_overlay.py; call validate(repo, baseline, OLP-0101..0200, declarations=combined receipt math_text entries, structural_reviews=0151-0200 receipt structural reviews)
static_validation.interpretation: The validator proves only byte bindings and conservative lexical/structural invariants. It explicitly does not prove semantic equivalence; this review supplies the independent reading but records repairs instead of converting the validator result into a blanket acceptance.

terminology_coverage.assessment: The pre-existing retrospective terminology ledgers do not yet provide decision-level rationale coverage for any unit in this range. The questions in this report are hash-bound provisional review records, not a claim of exhaustive occurrence coverage or official attestation.

findings.issue: The transitivity proof grafts two closed tableaux after Cut without first refreshing constants introduced by the quantified tableau rules. A constant fresh in its original tableau can occur in the other tableau's assumptions or above the graft, invalidating the rule instance after composition.

required_fix.text: وقبل تركيب الجدولين نعيد تسمية كل ثابت مستجد فيهما تسميةً جديدةً، بحيث لا يرد في افتراضات الجدول الآخر ولا في الفرع الواقع فوق موضع إلحاقه.

findings.issue: The Cut/grafting construction combines independently valid tableaux but does not refresh their quantified-rule constants against the enlarged assumption context.

required_fix.text: وقبل إلحاق الجدولين بالفرعين نعيد تسمية كل ثابت مستجد فيهما تسميةً جديدةً، بحيث لا يرد في افتراضات الجدول الآخر ولا في شيء واقع فوق موضع الإلحاق.

findings.issue: Nine occurrences use «الكمّيات» for formal quantifier operators while the same corpus normally uses «المكمّمات». The former is readily read as quantities or proposition quantity and breaks local consistency.
«تلزم ... ما (وعن ...)» is grammatically broken and obscures whether the inference rule is unary or binary.

findings.issue: Both quantified inference rules require the eigenconstant a to be absent from A(x), not merely from the premise set and B. Without that condition, for example A(x) := (x=a) turns the universally quantified rule unsound.

findings.issue: The final QR application needs a fresh constant, but the example never chooses a fresh a. If a already occurs in A(x) or B(y), the displayed application is not licensed.

findings.issue: Concatenating the two derivations enlarges the premise set and can invalidate QR eigenconstant conditions in either component. Earlier-line references alone do not preserve freshness.

findings.issue: After changing representatives from t to t′, the assumed non-satisfaction still names R(t). The intended well-definedness contradiction must assume non-satisfaction of R(t′).
The text equates models of the two axioms with all preorders, but this book's first-order structures have nonempty domains. Empty-carrier preorders are therefore silently excluded.

findings.issue: «كان الحد رمز ثابت» lacks the required accusative marking after كان.

findings.issue: The proof asks for equality of the value of every term, although the structures agree only on symbols occurring in A. The induction is valid only for terms occurring in A (and their subterms).

required_fix.text: ابدأ بالاستقراء على بنية كل حد~$t$ يرد في~$!A$ لإثبات أن قيمته واحدة في البنيتين، أي $\Value{t}{M_1}[s] = \Value{t}{M_2}[s]$.

findings.issue: English 'relations of arity k' is rendered first as «العلاقات ذات الرتبة k», which is especially misleading inside a section contrasting first and second logical order, and then inconsistently as «العلاقات k-المحلية».
«نماذج منتهية كبيرة اعتباطيًا» is a literal calque of 'arbitrarily large finite models' and can suggest models chosen capriciously rather than models of unbounded finite cardinality.

The induction claims preservation for an arbitrary partial isomorphism and arbitrary formula, but quantifier steps require p to belong to the witnessing back-and-forth family I, and all free variables of A must be among the paired x_i. The stated claim is false without both restrictions and the extension argument.
«وكل !!{structure}s متشاكلتين تتفقان فيها» mixes the universal plural token with a dual adjective and verb and has no idiomatic antecedent for «فيها».
